statement: let M0 : ℝ := Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + ∑' p : Nat.Primes, (Real.log (1 - 1 / (p.1 : ℝ)) + 1 / (p.1 : ℝ)); (0.261497 ≤ M0 ∧ M0 ≤ 0.261498) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ Real.exp 10 → Real.log (Real.log x) + M0 - (2.964e-6 : ℝ) / Real.log x ≤ (∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (Nat.ceil x)).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ)) ∧ (∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (Nat.ceil x)).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) + M0 + (if Real.log x > 8.9 then (1.614e-3 : ℝ) else (1 : ℝ))

plain_statement.en: Unconditional finite-range certification of Mertens' constant M0 ∈ [0.261497, 0.261498] and explicit two-sided bounds on ∑_{p < x} 1/p for all 2 ≤ x ≤ exp(10) (≈ 22,026.47), matching Johnston–Starichkova Lemma 3.2 (3.2)–(3.3).
plain_statement.zh: 无条件有限区间核验：证明 Meissel–Mertens 常数满足 0.261497 ≤ M₀ ≤ 0.261498，并在 2 ≤ x ≤ exp(10)（约 22,026）上给出 ∑_{p < x} 1/p 相对于 log log x + M₀ 的精确双边显式界。

brief.en: Certify M0 ∈ [0.261497, 0.261498] using finite prime tails + ζ(2) acceleration (or Euler–Maclaurin), then check ∑_{p < x} 1/p monotonically on each interval between consecutive primes up to 22,029 (note e^10 < 22027). Verified community imports (≤ 16 transitive) are permitted.
brief.zh: 先用有限素数尾和与 ∑_{p} 1/p² ≤ ζ(2) 认证 M₀ ∈ [0.261497, 0.261498]；在 [2, 22027] 内因 ∑_{p < x} 1/p 仅在素数处跳跃，按素数间隙分点检验单调极值即可全覆盖（仅需整数算术与可证对数上下界）。
